assertions.reason: plan 'Delivery profile and capacity': 'Profile: MVP', 3x25h x2wk x0.6 = ~90h, 25% reserve -> ~68h, phase 1 D01+G01-G07 estimated 57-79h with per-goal hour ranges and a day-6 cut rule.

Design D3/D4/I4: customer approves and pays on Shopify checkout (explicit confirmation); set_cart_line uses absolute quantity with read-back so retry gives 2 not 4; G02 acceptance tests this in phase 1.
Phase 2 table G08-G14 has estimate, primary/supporting skill and trigger, and the 'Later' table has trigger + accepted risk + skill; but phase 2 goals have no per-goal acceptance criteria.
Plan states 'Order of usefulness if time runs out: G01 -> G02 -> G03 (demoable local agent ...), then G04 -> G06 (hosted, bounded API), then G05 -> G07'.
Design names 'Limited-launch production MVP' and plan has a day-by-day 3-person calendar, but no hour estimates per goal, no capacity total and no reserve.

Checkout handoff gives explicit customer confirmation (D3, I3 'quantities the shopper confirmed'), but D3 relies on 'add/update lines' with 'one retry on timeout' and argues idempotency is unneeded because the cart is non-binding; retry may create an orphan cart and nothing stops a doubled line.
Post-MVP G05-G12 list primary/supporting skills and some triggers ('if p50 > ~6 s', 'only if founders reverse A4'), but no acceptance and no separate later list with triggers and accepted risk.

Goals are sequenced G01 (measured recs) -> G02 -> G03 -> G04 with a calendar, but there is no explicit fallback/cut rule or statement of what is still useful if time runs out; launch (G04) depends on everything.

reasons: A sizes phase 1 to the team with per-goal hour estimates, a 25% reserve, a day-6 cut rule and an explicit usefulness order; B gives only a calendar with no estimates, reserve or fallback.

A makes cart writes retry-safe with absolute-quantity set and read-back (tested in G02), and adds a later list with triggers and accepted risk; B dismisses idempotency for cart writes and has a thinner post-MVP handoff.

A: The phase 1 upper estimate (79h) exceeds the usable 68h, so the reserve is consumed (acknowledged, with a cut rule)
B: No hour estimates, capacity calculation or reserve for the two-week MVP
Cart update uses add semantics with a retry and no idempotency guard
No cut rule or 'if time runs out' ordering
No separate deferred list with triggers and accepted risk; post-MVP goals lack acceptance
